  • Method Details

    • open

      @MainThread public static void open(@NonNull android.app.Activity host, @NonNull java.lang.Runnable beforeImport)
      Open the SDK file-import page. After a file is selected and before import, beforeImport runs on the main thread. Close existing HiFaceSdk instances, camera flows, and feature pages in that callback. Cancelling selection does not call it. A callback exception aborts import. Recreate closed sessions even if the candidate is rejected. Prefer an application-scoped static method reference to avoid retaining an Activity. The callback is not persisted. After process recreation, a lost callback requires returning to the host and reopening the page; cleanup is never skipped.

    • isImporting

      @MainThread public static boolean isImporting()
      Indicates only that the built-in page is importing a file. The host may postpone creating new sessions.
